constraints.generation: Retained outputs are repetitive and drift to the repository-document training domain.
constraints.rare_tail: Original uncorrected residual harms rare tokens; ratio family has a small improving point estimate, not a separately established tail confidence interval.
constraints.order_control: Retuned reversed-history ratio ties the full-history ratio; no unique chronological-order claim.
constraints.warm_recipe: Fresh optimizer plus re-anchored exported masters, served window objective, extra exposure and grounded rehearsal. No single-cause optimizer attribution and no checkpoint-continuation claim.
constraints.fresh_secondary: The warm-composite follow-up uses the now-exposed books with unchanged transferred coefficients; it is not another blind draw.
constraints.generation_population: The original six-prompt generator covers two of the four book sources; NLL covers all four. No all-source generation coverage claim.
